name: The Harvesters

tenures.source: the fed's own Evolution of 31 March 2003, served at /promotions/gw/archive/evolution-results-2003-03-31.html; the fed's own WrestleCade III of 2 May 2003, served at /promotions/gw/archive/wrestlecade-3-results-2003-05-02.html; the fed's own promo board, served at /promotions/gw/rp/night-time.html
tenures.note: Nine men stand in the line at the induction of 2 May 2003 and nine Harvester names are declared, but the record attaches only six of them to a man: Fear to Salaok, Minds to Johnathon Davis, Pain to Mark Kullypso, Suffering to Grendel, Silence to Flare and Tears to Sage Sabbot, who is the man under the hood. Violence, Sorrow and Blood go unattributed in the line — though Roz Blayze's own promo of 6 April names Derek Draven the Harvester of Sorrow, and names himself the Harvester of Tears four weeks before the fed gave that name to Sabbot on air. Silent Wind is the Harvester of Death and had left by the time of the ceremony; he is listed here because the fed's own text still insists on it — "Remember Jude, you are The Harvester of Death still."

caption: An order that says it has existed for centuries and inducts by name at sunset at the edge of a gully — of Fear, Minds, Pain, Suffering, Violence, Silence, Sorrow, Blood and Tears — and whose Harvester of Death walked out and was told he still carried the title anyway.
